data.name: Impurity
data.detailed_description:
BUILD, EXPLORE, SURVIVE

Step into a dark fantasy sandbox where every decision shapes your settlement and the world around it. Lead your people directly in a breathing open world, balancing exploration, combat, and survival as you carve out your place in a hostile land.

Engage with rival settlements through trade, diplomacy, or conflict, while venturing into dangerous regions filled with powerful enemies, hidden locations, and unpredictable encounters. Adapt to changing conditions, respond to emerging threats, and push deeper into the unknown to secure your colony’s future.

BUILD YOUR SETTLEMENT

Build and expand your colony from a fragile outpost into a thriving stronghold. Every structure serves a purpose, shaping your production, survival, and defences.

Place buildings freely and grow your settlement over time, unlocking new options as you progress. Establish production chains, manage resources, and reinforce your colony to withstand incoming threats. What you build and how you lay it out directly impacts the efficiency and resilience of your people.

A LIVING COLONY

Recruit unique companions with their own roles, needs, and behaviours. Assign jobs, manage their survival, and watch your settlement evolve as they work, rest, and endure.

Each companion brings different strengths and weaknesses, gaining experience over time and becoming more effective in their role. Keep them fed, safe, and stable, or risk losing control as pressure builds. Their condition directly affects your settlement, influencing how your colony grows and functions.

EXPLORE A HOSTILE WORLD

Venture into procedurally generated lands filled with dangerous monuments, rare resources, rival settlements, and powerful bosses. Every journey is a risk.

Discover new locations, uncover valuable rewards, and face encounters that can shift the course of your run. Trade, negotiate, or fight as you interact with other settlements, and push deeper into the world to secure what your colony needs.

ENDURE RELENTLESS SEASONS

Shifting temperatures and deadly events shape the challenges your colony faces. Harsh weather and unpredictable occurrences force you to adapt, plan ahead, and stay prepared. Keep your people steady as conditions change, or risk losing control when it matters most.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH

Embrace divine blessings or dark corruption. Your choices shape your abilities, unlock unique rituals, and influence how your settlement evolves.

Follow a path that defines your playstyle, whether through guiding your people with light or pursuing power through darker means.

FEATURES

  • Open world sandbox
    Explore a procedurally generated dark fantasy world filled with dangerous monuments, rival settlements, and powerful bosses.

  • Settlement building and management
    Build, expand, and manage your colony from the ground up. Assign jobs, create production chains, and keep your people alive.

  • Living companions system
    Recruit unique companions with their own roles, needs, and progression. Train them, equip them, and shape your settlement through them.

  • Dynamic world and events
    Face shifting seasons, temperature changes, and unique events that constantly challenge your colony.

  • Exploration, trade, and conflict
    Interact with rival settlements through trade, diplomacy, or war as you venture deeper into the world.

  • Path system
    Choose between divine blessings or dark corruption, unlocking different abilities, rituals, and playstyles.

  • Third-person combat
    Fight alongside your companions against dangerous enemies and powerful bosses in real-time combat.

data.short_description: Build and lead a settlement in a ruthless dark fantasy world. Command companions, explore shifting open world lands, and navigate rival settlements - trading, allying, or waging war. Walk the path of light or corruption as you endure relentless seasons and ancient horrors.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD RX 580 / RTX 2060 (Laptop)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3080 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD required

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains dark fantasy themes, including combat, killing of human and creature enemies, and the presence of corpses and skeletons. Players may encounter unsettling events and psychological effects such as sanity loss. Violence is not excessively graphic and does not include explicit gore.
